entities.summary: David Davidovich Burliuk was a Ukrainian poet, artist and publicist associated with the Futurist and Neo-Primitivist movements. Burliuk has been described as "the father of Russian Futurism.". David Burliuk was a poets & playwrights from Semyrotivschyna (1882-07-21, Semyrotivschyna–1967-01-15). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
